decision: Reference mesh (80.5M faces) retained as Candidate E due to decimation topology limitations

candidate_E.description: Certified reference mesh at 0.30mm voxel resolution
candidate_E.note: This is the authoritative certified representation. Decimation to lower face counts breaks topology with current tools.

10M_faces.repair_result: PARTIAL - 206 non-manifold edges remain, not watertight

root_cause: Quadric edge collapse decimation (trimesh/pymeshlab) optimizes geometric error, not topological correctness. No available local tool preserves watertight/manifold/single-body through aggressive decimation.
recommendation: Use reference mesh (80.5M faces) as Candidate E for Phase 2 Slicer Validation. For manufacturing workflows requiring smaller STL, invest in topology-preserving decimation pipeline or cloud-based decimation service.
phase_2_readiness: READY - Reference mesh is topology-certified and volume-certified
